lines.beaver: 소식 들었어요? 민지가 다음 달에 결혼한대요.
lines.beaver_en: Did you hear? Minji is getting married next month.
lines.beaver_roman: sosik deureosseoyo? minjiga daeum dare gyeolhonhandaeyo.
lines.learner: 설마 민지가 벌써 시집가겠어요? 못 믿겠어요.
lines.en: Surely Minji isn't getting married already? I can't believe it.
lines.roman: seolma minjiga beolsseo sijipgagesseoyo? mon mitgesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It's true. They say her partner is American.
lines.en: An international marriage? Surely that's not true?

lines.beaver_en: I only heard it too. But it's certain.
lines.en: Minji still hasn't forgotten her first love.

lines.beaver_en: Right. But she says she broke up with him.
lines.en: A breakup? Their affection was so deep.

lines.beaver: 그 후에 미국 사람을 만났대요. 지금 약혼자예요.
lines.beaver_en: After that she met an American. He's her fiancé now.
lines.beaver_roman: geu hue miguk sarameul mannatdaeyo. jigeum yakonjayeyo.
lines.en: She had a fiancé? Is that really so?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, they got engaged last year. His name is Michael.
lines.en: Surely Minji wouldn't hide it from me? That's strange.

lines.beaver_en: She says she was too shy to tell anyone.
lines.learner: 그럼 마이클 씨도 곧 장가가는 거네요.
lines.en: Then Michael is getting married soon too.
lines.roman: geureom maikeul ssido got janggaganeun geoneyo.

lines.beaver: 네. 민지가 요즘 아주 행복해 보인대요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes. They say Minji looks really happy these days.
lines.beaver_roman: ne. minjiga yojeum aju haengbokae boindaeyo.
lines.en: That's a relief. As long as Minji is happy, that's enough.

lines.beaver_en: Then shall we go to the wedding together?
lines.en: Sure. If I see it myself, I'll congratulate her fully.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그럼 결혼식 날 같이 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Great. Then let's go together on the wedding day.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. geureom gyeolhonsing nal gachi gayo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll ask Minji myself then.
